curation.lead:
Jared Kushner served as Senior Adviser to President Donald Trump from January 2017 to January 2021, overseeing a Middle East diplomacy portfolio that included the Abraham Accords. His 2019 financial disclosure listed more than 100 real estate entities across seven trusts, with estimated disclosed asset value between $174 million and $710 million [Finding #4359] [Finding #4360].

After leaving the White House, Kushner launched Affinity Partners, a private equity firm that received a $2 billion commitment from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund, a decision made over the PIF advisory board's recorded objection [Finding #4331]. SEC filings show he became a Director of QXO Inc. (Brad Jacobs's company), with approximately 32.7 million shares valued at roughly $630 million, representing Affinity Partners's entire disclosed public equity portfolio [Finding #4322].

Analysis of financial records suggests two parallel channels of Gulf sovereign wealth flowing to Trump-connected entities: the MBS/Saudi PIF channel to Affinity Partners, and the Abu Dhabi/Sheikh Tahnoon channel to World Liberty Financial and MGX. Rick Gerson appears in both channels as an intermediary [Finding #4339]. During the Trump transition, Gerson delivered a Russia relations plan co-drafted with Kirill Dmitriev — head of the Russian Direct Investment Fund — to Kushner on January 18, 2017 [Finding #4331].
curation.system_role: Kushner links the Trump family's political network to Gulf sovereign wealth funds (Saudi PIF, Abu Dhabi) and post-White House private equity. After serving as Senior Adviser with a Middle East diplomacy portfolio, he launched Affinity Partners, which received a $2 billion commitment from Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund.

sections.title: Gulf Sovereign Capital and Affinity Partners
sections.content:
Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund committed $2 billion to Affinity Partners after Kushner left the White House, a decision documented in the public record as having been made over the objection of the PIF's own advisory board [Finding #4331]. LittleSis, which uses a defined relationship-strength taxonomy, categorizes the Kushner-Mohammed bin Salman relationship as "close friends" — the highest available category, above professional or associate-level [Finding #4331].

SEC filings and LittleSis records together suggest that the MBS/PIF-to-Affinity channel is structurally parallel to a second Gulf channel: Abu Dhabi under Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed routing sovereign capital to World Liberty Financial via MGX. Analysis of these records identifies four shared features in both channels: sovereign wealth fund capital, no FARA registration, deal timing following White House departure, and Abraham Accords diplomatic relationships underlying the commercial ones [Finding #4339]. Rick Gerson — described by UAE officials as "Kushner's guy" — appears in both channels as an intermediary [Finding #4331] [Finding #4339].

SEC filings show Affinity Partners's entire disclosed public equity portfolio concentrated in a single position: QXO Inc., where Kushner sits on the board of directors. He received grants of 9.3 million shares in August 2024 at $9.14 per share and 16.3 million shares in April 2025 at $12.30 per share, bringing total direct and indirect holdings to approximately 32.7 million shares worth roughly $630 million [Finding #4322].

sections.title: White House Tenure and Financial Disclosures
sections.content:
Kushner's 2019 OGE Form 278e (covering calendar year 2018) disclosed more than 100 individual real estate LLCs across seven trusts spanning New Jersey, New York, Illinois, Maryland, Missouri, Pennsylvania, Ohio, and Connecticut. Key holdings included Westminster Management LLC (distributing $1.5 million), Cadre — the real estate investment platform — valued at $25–50 million, and multiple KC Profit Participation entities structured as profit interests ranging from $1 million to $25 million each [Finding #4359] [Finding #4360]. Ivanka Trump's Old Post Office hotel generated $3,952,480 in revenue during the same period, while she also served as a White House adviser [Finding #4359].

ACRIS records document Kushner's personal address at 372 Central Park West, Unit 10R, New York, NY 10025, recorded in a March 2023 agreement for $1,300,000 with Frederick G. Kushner of New Orleans [Finding #4379]. Separately, Deutsche Bank private wealth manager Rosemary Vrablic held a dual professional and business relationship with Kushner, personally managing family accounts and approving loans that other banks had declined; she resigned from Deutsche Bank in November 2021 amid internal investigations [Finding #4332].

sections.title: Russia Transition Backchannel
sections.content:
During the Trump transition, Rick Gerson — Kushner's close personal friend of more than ten years — delivered a U.S.-Russia relations plan to Kushner on January 18, 2017. The plan was co-drafted with Kirill Dmitriev, CEO of the Russian Direct Investment Fund (RDIF), and subsequently shared with Vladimir Putin [Finding #4331]. LittleSis records a direct Kushner-Dmitriev relationship and separately documents that Erik Prince met Dmitriev in the Seychelles that same month, in what the Mueller investigation documented as a backchannel effort.

LittleSis also records two relationship entries between Kushner and Russian Ambassador Sergey Kislyak dated April 27, 2016, and documents Kushner's association with George Nader — who served as a backchannel intermediary between the Trump transition and UAE/Saudi officials and was later convicted of child sex trafficking [Finding #4331]. In October 2025, Steve Witkoff and Kushner held joint meetings with Dmitriev at the Faena Miami to negotiate a Ukraine peace plan; Dmitriev publicly credited both for their assistance [Finding #4339].

During the same transition period, both Erik Prince and Stephen Feinberg independently pitched Afghan war privatization plans to the Trump White House through Kushner and Steve Bannon.

sections.title: DFC, Adam Boehler, and the Gulf Relationship
sections.content:
Adam Boehler — Kushner's Harvard summer roommate — served as the first CEO of the U.S. International Development Finance Corporation (DFC) from December 2019 to January 2021, holding a $60 billion lending authority. Boehler traveled with Kushner to Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Qatar in 2020–2021 on delegations that produced the Abraham Accords. The DFC's geographic mandate — Middle East, Africa, South and Southeast Asia — overlaps with Affinity Partners' stated target markets [Finding #4349].

American Oversight obtained a 423-page FOIA of Boehler-Kushner communications (DocumentCloud 21044267, released August 2021). The document set covers only the March–April 2020 period and contains exclusively COVID-19 pandemic response content — ventilators, PPE, testing logistics. It contains no references to Saudi Arabia, the UAE, Qatar, PIF, sovereign wealth, investment funds, MBS, the Gulf, Middle East, Israel, the Abraham Accords, Gerson, real estate, Affinity, DFC projects, or the BUILD Act [Finding #4354]. The Gulf relationship-building period documented in other sources falls outside this FOIA window [Finding #4354].

sections.title: Political Donations and Family Coordination
sections.content:
Kushner donated $844,600 to the Trump 47 Committee Inc. on May 31, 2024 [Finding #4331]. FEC records show that in June 2024, he and his father Charles Kushner made identical $10,000 donations to the same state Republican party committees — including South Dakota, Kentucky, New Mexico, and South Carolina — on the same dates. Analysis of FEC records suggests this pattern is consistent with participation in a shared joint fundraising committee structure; Charles Kushner's total 2024 giving exceeded $420,000, including $155,000 to MAGA Inc [Finding #4326].

Kushner's attorney of record is Abbe Lowell, who has also represented Hunter Biden. LittleSis records Lowell's connection to the Epstein network through Kathryn Ruemmler [Finding #4331] [Finding #4379].

open_questions: The Boehler-Kushner FOIA covers only March–April 2020; what communications, if any, occurred in 2020–2021 during the Abraham Accords period that would document how Gulf sovereign wealth relationships were initiated prior to Affinity Partners' launch? [Finding #4354]

Did Kushner or Affinity Partners file any FARA registration disclosures related to the Saudi PIF investment or to advisory services provided to Gulf state entities, and if not, on what legal basis was registration deemed unnecessary? [Finding #4339]

What is the complete governance and LP structure of Affinity Partners, including who sits on any advisory boards, what fee arrangements apply to the Saudi PIF and other sovereign capital, and whether any Trump administration policy decisions are referenced in deal documentation? [Finding #4322] [Finding #4331]

What is the relationship between Kushner's QXO directorship and Affinity Partners' concentrated single-stock portfolio — specifically, whether the directorship preceded or followed the investment decision, and what governance processes governed that concentration? [Finding #4322]

What communications exist between Rick Gerson, Kirill Dmitriev, and Jared Kushner from the January 2017 backchannel period through the October 2025 Faena Miami meetings, and have any been produced to any oversight body? [Finding #4331]
